summary: [Plaid] rate-limits: Per-endpoint, per-item caps (per Plaid developer docs summary): /transactions/sync and /transactions/get 15 requests/min per item; /transactions/refresh 2 requests/day per item; /accounts/balance/get institution-dependent (live query); most other endpoints no published limit. Guidance: trigger off webhooks not polling, exponential backoff, advisory locks per item. Re-verify numeric limits against current Plaid rate-limits docs at implementation time.
